nom: Cetaphil Hydrating Moisturizing Cream Body Moisturizer

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, chapped or cracked skin (hands, elbows, heels, winter skin) repeatedly report the cream relieves dryness and roughness, though one reviewer with dry skin found it did not absorb and left her skin dry again within hours.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin, rosacea, eczema or dermatitis report the fragrance-free formula is calming and non-irritating, with one exception who reacted with redness and irritation, which she attributed to the niacinamide content.
segments.combination: One reviewer notes the cream moisturizes without making skin oily, describing it as suited to combination-leaning skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes it as beneficial for normal to dry skin with a texture and scent she likes.
segments.mature: A reviewer using it on her mother-in-law's very sensitive, mature skin in a cold climate found it deeply hydrating and needed multiple applications a day.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report the cream relieves dryness, flakiness, roughness and chapped skin, often within days and lasting through the day; one reviewer with dry skin says it did not keep her moisturized and her skin turned dry again within hours.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report calming, non-irritating effects and no flare-ups, while one reviewer reports the cream caused instant redness and irritation on her face.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer using it for topical dermatitis reports it calms the skin, restores the barrier and helps with itchiness; another reports it did not sting during an eczema flare.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the cream cleared white dry patches/spots on her skin over time.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including a teenage son described as acne-prone and a person with body acne, report no new breakouts and some improvement in breakouts; one reviewer with bad acne says the product felt too thick and heavy for daily facial use and preferred a lighter alternative.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with normal-to-oily leaning skin report the cream moisturizes without leaving an oily or greasy film.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture feels heavy in summer

extraits.texte: If you're one of the unlucky people whose face does NOT like niacinamide, avoid this! I didn't realize that B3 = niacinamide until this cream made my face turn instantly red and irritated. Now I have a big tub of body lotion instead.

This is a good product but not for me personally 🥰 it didnt effect my skin how I wanted it to or moisturized my skin in a way I was happy with, it didnt really absorb in my skin & after using my skin would become dry again with just a few hours which is not ok because with my other moisture products it would not make my skin dry again after a few hours, I did use this for a consistent amount of time & would not use it again for my dry skin, but to each it's own, I would say try it out for yourself!

I enjoyed this cetaphil moisturizer, but it's really thick which can feel really heavy on my face. I would not use this daily since I had bad acne. I would most likely use cerave over cetaphil because it is more absorbent.

extraits.titre: Hydrating and great for all skin types!
extraits.texte: This is such a cult classic cream - light, not greasy, hydrating, and fragrance free. Works for all skin types and the entire family uses it! My teenage son who is acne prone in particular uses this regularly with no issues.

As someone who has body acne, this cream helps me a lot. It hydrates my skin and helps with breakouts. It's good for dry skin. I really like the smell, and I always use it at night, but I think we can use it during the day as well. It's a really great cream. I've been using it for three years now.

As a girl with very sensitive skin I always have a hard time finding a moisturizer that is not going to irritate my skin and this is that! This is so soft on my skin, doesn't flare up my rosacea, and helps my skin feel nice and moisturized

It does the job! The dermatologist recommended it to me for topical dermatitis. It calms the skin and restores the barrier. Helpful with itchiness. No particular scent. Jar package allows to scoop all away and y a long time
